[Benzinga news, 2026-11-02T14:01:39Z, by staff] Novartis Phase III ORION-4 Trial of Pelacarsen Misses Primary Endpoint
Novartis announced that its Phase III ORION-4 clinical trial for pelacarsen did not meet its primary endpoint.
Novartis reported that the Phase III ORION-4 trial evaluating pelacarsen failed to achieve its primary endpoint. The company indicated that full results from the study will be presented at an upcoming American Heart Association meeting and published in a medical journal. This development represents a setback for the company's cardiovascular pipeline.
